authority: Root coordinator, acting on the user instruction to use reasonable processing assumptions, explicitly permits qualified contextual I/l transcription where actual source glyphs are visually identical.
requirements: Preserve the actual visible glyph form and all plausible I/l alternatives; do not claim pixel case discrimination when none exists.
Record the exact sourceId, physicalPage, sourceRowOnPage, character position(s), proposed literal display name and interpretation basis for every qualified field.

Surname alphabetical placement or demonstrated source initial-capital convention may support an explicit contextual transcription. Do not infer a full name, use dictionary expansion or substitute an unrelated letter.
Qualified values remain distinct from exact-glyph resolutions and require peer review plus root adoption of the exact case ledger.
Every affected source must carry a publicWarning identifying the qualified name observations and linking their exact evidence/alternative ledger.
Only the name field can receive a typography qualification. Monetary, date, employer, position, page and multiplicity uncertainty is not waived.
Existing frozen raw outputs, benchmark transcripts, ordinary batches and the earlier accepted FY2024/25 workflow remain unchanged.
receiptShape: Keep the ordinary seven resolution keys. A qualified row uses the qualified status and a top-level sourceTypographyQualifications list (or a separately pinned exact case ledger) keyed by physicalPage/sourceRowOnPage. Record proposedName, visibleAlternatives, characterPositions, assumptionBasis and actualSourceEvidence/crop hashes. Do not silently broaden unrequested fields.
